ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (off-white/light-grey) surface with high-contrast low-intensity (black/dark-grey) focal points; estimated macro-level ratio of 85:15 across visible pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous light field containing numerous discrete, high-contrast dark circular and elliptical blobs (mottling/rosettes) distributed across both lobes; a dark gradient is visible extending from the central notch downwards.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex and an approximate internal angle of 40-45 degrees dividing the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and jagged trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, varying amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) along the entire visible linear boundary, particularly pronounced on the distal edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct dark linear disruptions detected; a prominent horizontal mark on the mid-right lobe and multiple shorter, diagonal rake-like marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Widespread circular rosette scarring throughout the ventral surface; significant irregular serration of the trailing edge likely resulting from cumulative environmental or biotic interactions.
other_distinctive_markers: Characteristic dark pigmentation zones flanking the central notch, creating a localized high-contrast dark region against the otherwise light-toned lobe surfaces.
